item.text:
# VFX Reference Dossier — fork

## Candidate 1: Celestial Tornado Shot Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Celestial Tornado Shot Effect
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_XtINEHQqd0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_XtINEHQqd0)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3194826](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3194826); [https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/CelestialTornadoShotEffect](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/CelestialTornadoShotEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: A primary arrow travels to the target location, creates a distinct transition node, and releases several secondary stellar projectiles—a particularly clean visualization of projectile-to-projectiles branching.
- readability_notes: Bright star trails contrast strongly against the dark ground, making both the split point and outgoing trajectories legible. Repeated casts eventually create substantial overlap.

## Candidate 2: Elemental Arrow — Frost Arrow (Diablo III)
- source_game: Diablo III
- skill_or_mtx_name: Elemental Arrow — Frost Arrow
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K-eVr9I7xrs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K-eVr9I7xrs)
- secondary_urls: [https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-gb/class/demon-hunter/active/elemental-arrow](https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-gb/class/demon-hunter/active/elemental-arrow)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The primary frost arrow visibly hits one enemy and splits into up to ten secondary arrows directed into the space beyond that target. It is an unusually literal, forward-biased fork_split reference.
- readability_notes: Saturated blue projectiles and discrete trails read clearly at Diablo III’s gameplay camera. Rapid fire can obscure individual branch points, so isolated casts are the best reference frames.

## Candidate 3: Panetti’s Replicating Missile (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Panetti’s Replicating Missile
- primary_url: [https://www.youtube.com/live/-067frgXKvE](https://www.youtube.com/live/-067frgXKvE)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.grimdawn.com/guide/character/masteries/arcanist/](https://www.grimdawn.com/guide/character/masteries/arcanist/); [https://grimdawn-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Panetti%27s_Replicating_Missile_%28Skill%29](https://grimdawn-archive.fandom.com/wiki/Panetti%27s_Replicating_Missile_%28Skill%29)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: A concentrated arcane missile crosses the battlefield and replicates into multiple fragments on contact. The dedicated skill-overview format supplies repeated full cast-to-fragment cycles.
- readability_notes: The luminous primary orb and fan of fragments remain visible against Grim Dawn’s muted terrain. Proc-heavy endgame builds are noisier, but this focused overview preserves the core silhouette.

## Candidate 4: Lightning Fury (Diablo II: Resurrected)
- source_game: Diablo II: Resurrected
- skill_or_mtx_name: Lightning Fury
- primary_url: [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23719810/diablo-ii-resurrected-class-guide-showcase-ft-dbrunski125](https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/23719810/diablo-ii-resurrected-class-guide-showcase-ft-dbrunski125)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_j0xAfboBpk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_j0xAfboBpk); [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pSSQPUi0ccM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pSSQPUi0ccM)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The thrown javelin establishes a strong primary trajectory, then contact releases lightning projectiles toward surrounding enemies. It demonstrates a target-seeking fork rather than a mechanically uniform radial split.
- readability_notes: Blue-white bolts are highly visible, and the throw-to-discharge transition reads immediately. Dense enemy packs produce a lightning web, so lower-density examples are better for studying individual branches.

## Candidate 5: Splitting Steel (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Splitting Steel
- primary_url: [https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3109096](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3109096)
- secondary_urls: [https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2940439](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2940439)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The second embedded clip in the official article shows a single metallic projectile dividing at its target point into multiple outgoing shards, followed by compact impact bursts. Mechanically and spatially, it is one of the closest references to a literal fork_split.
- readability_notes: The sharp launch sound, narrow projectile trail, and clustered impacts reinforce the phase boundaries. Metallic shards are less chromatically distinct than the elemental candidates and become harder to track during dense combat.

## Search log
- Searched Path of Exile shop, announcement, and official-video results for “fork projectile,” “Split Arrow,” “Tornado Shot,” “Celestial Tornado Shot,” and “Splitting Steel”; retained the two official clips with the clearest downstream branching.
- Searched Diablo III’s official game guide and YouTube results for Magic Missile — Split, Cluster Arrow, and Elemental Arrow — Frost Arrow. Magic Missile was rejected because its spread originates at cast time; Cluster Arrow reads more as a bomblet payload than a directional fork.
- Searched Grim Dawn skill pages and dedicated gameplay videos for Panetti’s Replicating Missile; found a focused skill-overview video plus official textual confirmation of replication on impact.
- Searched Blizzard’s Diablo II: Resurrected class showcases and dedicated Lightning Fury videos; retained the official Javazon feature and a lower-clutter supplementary showcase.
- Searched Last Epoch and Lost Ark official channels for isolated projectile-splitting showcases; results did not expose a comparably clear, verifiable fork example.
- Verified Titan Quest’s Scatter Shot Arrows description, but search did not surface strong dedicated video coverage, so it was excluded.
